high_level_description: This image depicts an empty indoor space that appears to be a large, open room with a high ceiling. The room is characterized by its clean, white tiled floor and pale yellow walls. There are several vertical columns supporting the ceiling, which adds to the spacious feel of the area. The room has large windows on one side, allowing natural light to flood in and providing a view of the outside. Through these windows, you can see some greenery and what looks like a street or another building in the distance. The windows have metal bars, suggesting they might be security measures.
